900110.title: Optical fibres, bundles and cables (bare fibre)
900110.boundary: Bare optical fibre; excludes finished telecom/subsea cable systems and repeaters.

854470.title: Optical fibre cables (sheathed)
854470.boundary: Made-up optical fibre cables; routes through integrators; not subsea-system builders.

811292.title: Germanium/gallium etc. (unwrought basket)
811292.boundary: Shared 811292 basket — germanium (the fibre dopant) not separable; upstream context only.
